## Independent reviewer reproduction

Run from a shell where TLS verification is enabled:

```powershell
$env:NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = '1'
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = '1'
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
git diff --check
git status --short
```

Pass means the frozen install exits `0`; CI exits `0` with 2 test files and 11 unit tests plus the forbidden-import and governance-artifact checks; governance reports 7 passing tests; `git diff --check` exits `0`; and only the exact Prompt 03 paths above differ from base commit `5c944fb501e6f091c768421eaf0c2e0452ea8245`.
